price_data.holiday_coverage_note: 2025 gaps checked against NSE capital-market holiday circular; 2026 against NSE equities holiday page. Historical 2018-2024 gaps are not individually classified; 2026 weekday gaps outside listed holidays remain unexplained, not imputed.

corporate_actions.field_limitations: Rows observed identify dividend, bonus, demerger and rights for RELIANCE; no split, buyback, merger, symbol change or delisting row was present in this response. `raw_subject` is retained by provider. This does not establish that unobserved action classes never occurred.
corporate_actions.provider_coverage_claim: All recorded actions for symbol; no completeness guarantee documented.

symbol_history.source: TejHQ published symbol_history tree and free-key /v1/symbols endpoint
symbol_history.delisting_semantics: No explicit delisting event/status documented; a final valid_to/price observation is not a verified delisting notice.

adjusted_prices.published_convention: back-adjusted close: adj_close = close * adj_factor_cumulative; cumulative factor multiplies actions with ex_date after row date, per instrument chain.
adjusted_prices.adjusted_ohlc: No adj_open, adj_high or adj_low are defined in the published adjusted tree schema. The original open/high/low/close columns remain raw; only additional adj_close is adjusted. Do not synthesize adjusted OHLC.
adjusted_prices.corporate_action_factor_policy: split fv_to/fv_from; bonus M/(N+M); dividend (previous-session close - cash)/previous-session close; rights, buybacks, demergers and mergers factor 1.0 under stated NSE convention.
adjusted_prices.api_probe_error: key_required; API indicates free key required. No key was configured or requested.

execution_audit.signal_timing: Completed bar t is appended and signal generated after close; pending order fills only when session date > signal date.
execution_audit.opening_stop_gap: Existing position stop logic uses open when open <= stop, then adverse sell slippage.
execution_audit.intraday_stop: If open is above stop and low crosses it, simulated at stop then adverse sell slippage.
execution_audit.ambiguous_stop_target: Stop is processed first, conservative stop selected if both touched.
execution_audit.volume_cash_positions: Full order rejected when volume cap, cash incl costs, or position limit fails. Pending book keyed by symbol prevents more than one pending buy per symbol; local PaperBroker has idempotent client order IDs, backtester itself does not submit broker orders.
execution_audit.fee_application: Fee schedule calculates brokerage, side-specific STT, exchange, GST on brokerage+exchange, buy stamp and sell DP per share. Cost is assigned once to each filled entry/exit ledger row; tests assert trade cost equals ledger costs.
execution_audit.limitations: No statutory rounding, minimum brokerage, broker tiers or exchange calendar. Stops do not guarantee real execution price. Raw unadjusted position quantity/cash is not changed for splits/bonus, dividends are not credited, and rights/demerger/merger are not modeled. The 2026 missing weekdays can distort next-observation execution.

cost_profile.note: No current rates are asserted. A cost-inclusive label requires sourced verification, at least one nonzero rate, and effective date coverage; applicable components and broker terms still require primary-source review.

blockers: 104 weekday gaps from 2018-2024 remain unclassified without those years' official calendars
